name: 18640 · Pittston, PA
findings: ZIP 18640 (Pittston) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18640 (Pittston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
